parameters.content:
## Book appointment
Validate booking (generated from src/nodes/validate-booking.ts) runs the ordered service/datetime/hours/slot-grid/notice/horizon checks before anything touches Calendar, counting no bookings yet; an ok:false result, or a missing booking limit in config.limits, stops there. Only a valid request reaches Get upcoming bookings, which reads Calendar from now to config.limits.max_booking_days_ahead (Always Output Data, so an empty calendar still continues); Prepare limit check counts the events whose description holds this exact phone ('Phone: <phone>' plus a line break, the line Validate booking writes), and Check booking limit reruns the same source with that count, so a phone already at config.limits.max_upcoming_bookings gets too_many_bookings. Only then does Recheck slot availability query Calendar for exactly [start, end), with Recurring Event Handling "expand" so a recurring hold is expanded to its real occurrence; Always Output Data keeps an empty result from stopping the branch. Any returned item (a real event has an id; an empty placeholder doesn't) means the slot was taken between the first check and now, so it returns slot_taken without creating anything. Only a still-free slot reaches Create calendar event, which uses Validate booking's own summary/description/start/end verbatim. A successful create upserts the patient as booked (last_appointment = start) and returns ok:true with the new event_id; any Calendar call's failure alerts the team through notify-team and reports calendar_unavailable, with team_notified set only when that alert actually sent.
